book.name: 2 Timoti
book.title: 2 TIMOTI Timoti ꞌina leta heluwena Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Nuwanuwagu ma nuwau ꞌida sabwalena tuta ꞌana ꞌebelosaloha ꞌinaonama weyahina, ꞌabehega tutaedi ꞌoidiya mwau baibaiwana ꞌabwa silatu.

Weyahina tutaedi ꞌoidiya nata tomota taudimo weyahidi sinuwanuwatuhu, ma wasawasa ꞌana hamwa nata ꞌimadou ꞌoidiya, ta sinuwa hanehane ta sigagasa ma wete siheliya. Ma sinadiyao ma tamadiyao ꞌenadi nata geya sihematamatana, ta tomota ꞌidi paihowa bwebweꞌadi weyahidi nata geya siloyauwedo.
Mumugadi guguyou ꞌoinega gesowana siꞌatemuyamuya, ma hesi siheꞌahwa panapanawa besobeso, ma toganawala hedade. Ma sigamwasowala besobeso wete, ta wete mumuga bwebweꞌana ꞌana tologwahatao,
toꞌwayama, ma galana ꞌoina sihewaiwai, ma gwae hane hedada, ma geya Yehoba sihelauwe, ta hesi taudimo ꞌidi yaliyaya weyahina sinuwanuwatuhu.
Tomotaedi sitapwatapwalolo tuwa ma Yehoba ꞌina waiwai geya sihemisae, ꞌoinega ꞌidi tapwaloloina tuwa ginaula besobeso, ꞌoinega bodaedi taudi sahena ꞌoidiya ꞌuluhuluhu.

Weyahina tupwadi ꞌoidiyega hadai siluhuluhu wahiwahine geya ꞌidi nuwatuhu paꞌalidi sabi ꞌabowedi, ma wahiwahineyedi sisanasanapu taudi topui, ꞌoinega ꞌamna hagana ma hagana silolotoho soladiya ta simulimuliyedi,
ꞌoinega heꞌita hagana ma hagana ꞌana tohesagohao ta geya sawasawahina ma heꞌita moisa sisanapu.
Tomotaedi heꞌita moisa siloꞌaleheya, gide taudi mwalo Yanisi ma Yamilisi Mosese siloꞌaleheya, ta ꞌadi ꞌita gide taudi tohemisa ma ꞌatediya ꞌabo ma nuwatuhu galadi simiyamiya.
Ma hesi muhemuhena sibeꞌu, ma tomota baibaiwadi siꞌitadi, mumugadi galadi gide mwalo Yanisi ma Yamilisi mumugadi galana, ta tomota siꞌiteya.
Ma ꞌowa boꞌi ꞌusanapugauwa, ꞌigu heꞌita, ta mumugagu, ꞌigu ꞌedao, ꞌigu hemisa, ꞌigu ꞌalamaꞌiꞌita, ta ꞌigu helau ta ꞌigu toholo paꞌala.

Ma ꞌasaedi Anitioki ma Ikoniyami ma Lisitila ꞌoidiya yamiyamwauwa ta ꞌagu muyaedi tomota ꞌoidiyega yalobediya wete ꞌusanasanapu, tupwaedi ꞌoidiya yamiyamwauwa moisa, ta mwauwedi mabwaiyadi ꞌoidiyega ꞌida Cinapwana ꞌiꞌabihetegauwa.
Moisa, ꞌeguma Yesu Keliso tahemisae, ma tatagwalegita ꞌina ꞌeda bwebweꞌadi ꞌoina, nata miyamwau tomota ꞌoidiyega taloba.
Ta wete taudi togala, ma tomota ꞌadi toꞌabowao ꞌidi puiyao sihemadou moisa, weyahina Seitani boꞌi ꞌiꞌabowediya.
Ta ꞌowa hesi heꞌitaedi ꞌuhemisa pwaidiya ta ꞌusanapudiya. Heꞌitaedi ꞌuda muliyedi, weyahina tauma ꞌino toheꞌitao boꞌi ꞌusanapumaiya ꞌabehega ꞌima heꞌitaowedi wete ꞌamulimuliyedi.
Ma ꞌowa ꞌuboi wete ꞌino tuta gwamega ma nige bewa Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌina gwae ꞌana tohasila, ta ꞌiheheꞌitego ꞌabehega ꞌida hemisa Yesu Keliso ꞌoina sowasowana ꞌiꞌabihetegita.
Ma weteyage Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌina gwae mabwaiyana Yehoba Yaluyaluwanega sitauyama, ta gwaeyedi ꞌoidiyega ꞌada heꞌita ma ꞌada lohatoto ma ꞌada gihedumwalu
ta ꞌida waiwai talobalobadi Yehoba ꞌina paihowao weyahidi, weyahina Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌina gwae ꞌoidiyega Yehoba ꞌiꞌatububugita, ta ꞌina paihowao bwebweꞌadi mabwaiyana sawasawahida.
